name: spawn_agent
description: Hatch a helper agent onto the desk. One per type: scout (maps the codebase), builder (builds features), fixer (fixes bugs), tester (writes tests), reviewer (reviews code), scribe (writes docs), shipper (changelogs and write-ups), designer (rocket design), sentinel (security).

name: assign_task
description: Give a crew member a self-contained task on the sample project (hatches it first if needed). It may change one file; code_undo takes the change back. Returns status working at once; say who's on it in a few words, then a system note says what it did.

agent.description: crew member, by type: scout, builder, fixer, tester, reviewer, scribe, shipper, designer, sentinel

task.description: self-contained instruction incl. context from the conversation

mode.description: qa = answer only, code or auto = may change a file

name: dismiss_agent
description: Send a crew member home (removes its albie, drops its current task).

name: crew_status
description: Who is on the crew and what each one is working on.
